steps.name: count
steps.expr: const qs=[...document.querySelectorAll('.qz')]; return qs.length+' questions · types '+JSON.stringify(qs.reduce((a,q)=>(a[q.dataset.type]=(a[q.dataset.type]||0)+1,a),{}))+' · figs '+[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-fig]')].map(f=>f.dataset.fig+':'+(f.querySelector('svg,table')?'ok':'EMPTY')).join(',')+' · progress: '+document.getElementById('quiz-progress').textContent

steps.name: point sft mask
steps.expr: const h=document.querySelector('.qz[data-q="q-sft-mask"]'); ['ans','end'].forEach(k=>h.querySelector('[data-pick="'+k+'"]').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true}))); const c=h.querySelector('.qz-check'); if(c) c.click(); return h.querySelector('.qz-verdict').textContent

steps.name: point agent
steps.expr: const h=document.querySelector('.qz[data-q="q-ag-mask"]'); ['a1','a2','fin','o1'].forEach(k=>h.querySelector('[data-pick="'+k+'"]').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true}))); const c=h.querySelector('.qz-check'); if(c) c.click(); return h.querySelector('.qz-verdict').textContent

steps.name: answer all
steps.expr: document.querySelectorAll('.qz').forEach(h=>{ if(h.classList.contains('done')) return; const t=h.dataset.type; if(t==='pick'||t==='point'){h.querySelectorAll('.qz-opts button')[0].click(); const c=h.querySelector('.qz-check'); if(c){c.click();}} else if(t==='sort'){h.querySelectorAll('table.qz-sort tr').forEach(tr=>tr.querySelector('button').click()); h.querySelector('.qz-check').click();} else if(t==='fill'){h.querySelectorAll('input.qz-blank').forEach(i=>{i.value='x'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));}); h.querySelector('.qz-check').click();} else {h.querySelector('.qz-check').click();} }); return document.getElementById('quiz-progress').textContent

steps.name: svg-text
steps.expr: const bad=[]; document.querySelectorAll('svg').forEach((s,si)=>{const sb=s.getBoundingClientRect(); const ts=[...s.querySelectorAll('text')]; ts.forEach((t,i)=>{const b=t.getBoundingClientRect(); if(b.left<sb.left-1||b.right>sb.right+1||b.top<sb.top-1||b.bottom>sb.bottom+1) bad.push('clip svg'+si+': '+t.textContent.slice(0,30)); for(let j=i+1;j<ts.length;j++){const c=ts[j].getBoundingClientRect(); if(b.left<c.right-1&&c.left<b.right-1&&b.top<c.bottom-1&&c.top<b.bottom-1) bad.push('overlap svg'+si+': '+t.textContent.slice(0,20)+' / '+ts[j].textContent.slice(0,20));}}); [...s.querySelectorAll('rect')].forEach(r=>{}); }); return bad.length? bad.join(' || ') : 'svg text clean ('+document.querySelectorAll('svg text').length+' labels)'

steps.name: text in boxes
steps.expr: const bad=[]; document.querySelectorAll('[data-pick]').forEach(g=>{const r=g.querySelector('rect:not(.hit)'); if(!r) return; const rb=r.getBoundingClientRect(); g.querySelectorAll('text').forEach(t=>{const b=t.getBoundingClientRect(); if(b.top>rb.top-2 && b.right>rb.right+1) bad.push(g.dataset.pick+': '+t.textContent);});}); return bad.length? 'OVERFLOW '+bad.join(' | ') : 'ok'
